# Navbar: `jl-navbar`

The bar at the top of an app: brand, main links and actions, folding its links on a narrow width.

- Class `JlNavbar`, a organism: `import { JlNavbar } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/navbar

The bar at the top of an app or a site: the brand at the start (slot="brand"), the main links, and
actions at the end (slot="actions"): a sign-in button, a search, an avatar. Each link is { label, href, active? }; the
active one is the page people are on, in the accent colour.

The bar watches its own width, not the window's: narrower than 720 pixels, the links fold into a menu button that
opens them as a list under the bar, so the same navbar works in a full page and in a narrow column. sticky keeps it
at the top while the page scrolls.

## Use

```ts
import { JlButton, JlIcon, JlNavbar } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlNavbar links={[{"label":"Overview","href":"#/components/navbar","active":true},{"label":"Projects","href":"#/components/navbar"},{"label":"Deployments","href":"#/components/navbar"},{"label":"Settings","href":"#/components/navbar"}]}>
  <span slot="brand"><JlIcon name="rocket" size={20} />Orbit</span>
  <JlButton slot="actions" variant="primary" label="New project" />
</JlNavbar>
```

```html
<jl-navbar links='[{"label":"Overview","href":"#/components/navbar","active":true},{"label":"Projects","href":"#/components/navbar"},{"label":"Deployments","href":"#/components/navbar"},{"label":"Settings","href":"#/components/navbar"}]'>
  <span slot="brand"><jl-icon name="rocket" size="20"></jl-icon>Orbit</span>
  <jl-button slot="actions" variant="primary" label="New project"></jl-button>
</jl-navbar>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `links` (attribute `links`): `NavbarLink[]`, default `[]`. The main links: { label, href, active? }.
- `sticky` (attribute `sticky`): `boolean`, default `false`. Stays at the top of the window while the page scrolls.
- `label` (attribute `label`): `string`, default `''`. The navigation’s name for screen readers. Empty: jlib's own text, in the language shown.

## Slots

- `brand`: The logo or the name of the app, at the start.
- `actions`: Buttons, a search or an avatar, at the end.

## Styling

- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The header element of the bar.
- `--max-width` (custom property): The widest the bar’s content gets, centred (none).

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### Brand, links and actions

```html
<jl-navbar links='[{"label":"Overview","href":"#/components/navbar","active":true},{"label":"Projects","href":"#/components/navbar"},{"label":"Deployments","href":"#/components/navbar"},{"label":"Settings","href":"#/components/navbar"}]'>
  <span slot="brand"><jl-icon name="rocket" size="20"></jl-icon>Orbit</span>
  <jl-button slot="actions" variant="ghost" label="Sign in"></jl-button>
  <jl-button slot="actions" variant="primary" label="New project"></jl-button>
</jl-navbar>
```

### Folded links

In a column narrower than 720 pixels, the links fold into the menu button: press it.

```html
<div class="narrow">
  <jl-navbar links='[{"label":"Overview","href":"#/components/navbar","active":true},{"label":"Projects","href":"#/components/navbar"},{"label":"Deployments","href":"#/components/navbar"},{"label":"Settings","href":"#/components/navbar"}]'>
    <span slot="brand"><jl-icon name="rocket" size="20"></jl-icon>Orbit</span>
    <jl-button slot="actions" variant="primary" size="sm" label="New"></jl-button>
  </jl-navbar>
</div>
```

### Actions only

Icon actions and no links: a bar for a single-page tool.

```html
<jl-navbar>
  <span slot="brand"><jl-icon name="rocket" size="20"></jl-icon>Orbit</span>
  <jl-button slot="actions" variant="ghost" icon="search" hint="Search"></jl-button>
  <jl-button slot="actions" variant="ghost" icon="bell" hint="Notifications"></jl-button>
  <jl-button slot="actions" icon="user" hint="Account"></jl-button>
</jl-navbar>
```
